# PerkCommons Next

PerkCommons Next is an experimental fork of PerkCommons: an open, evidence-led directory of opportunities. This development site is not the official production PerkCommons implementation.

## Public entry points

- About and methodology: /about/
- Browse opportunities: /opportunities/
- Public opportunity JSON: /data/opportunities.json
- Public opportunity API: /api/v1/opportunities
- OpenAPI description: /openapi.json

## Source and provenance

- Experimental site source: https://github.com/CodWasTaken/site
- Experimental public data: https://github.com/CodWasTaken/data

Published directory records should be interpreted with their source URLs, review state, and provenance. This file is an index to public project resources; it does not grant additional copyright, licensing, crawling, or AI-training rights beyond the rights that apply to the referenced material.
